name: AutomationDirect P1-15CDD2 input/output module
summary: P1-15CDD2 input/output module arrangement: mounting, interface and service-space coordination.
description: P1-15CDD2 is the drawing identifier for input/output module in AutomationDirect's Productivity1000 PAC collection. An input/output module joins field information and controller commands. A physical layout needs the selected module and its interfaces rather than a generic block of interchangeable I/O.

For example, in a machine panel combining field status and actuator commands, use the P1-15CDD2 reference to coordinate input and output conductor corridors, connector access and removal space. Show the neighbouring equipment and the connection route so the installer can understand the intended arrangement.

Use the reviewed native drawing identified as PLC Families/P1000/P1-15CDD2.dwg for the exact physical details. Locate the named file in its original manufacturer archive. Manufacturer drawing previews are shown only when an exact approved source is available. Any illustrative 3D view is a separate concept and is not to scale; use the selected manufacturer documents for dimensions, ratings and installation details.
readingNotes: Keep input and output conductor corridors, connector access and removal space visible in the layout.

This reference concerns the named P1-15CDD2 drawing and its input/output module role. A drawing in the same collection is not automatic evidence of compatible terminals, mounts or electrical performance.
